claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.wearer_spends_bonus_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The invisible condition granted by the ring ends when the wearer takes a Bonus Action to become visible again. No existing DurationEndTrigger variant covers a voluntary bonus-action deactivation by the bearer.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: until you take a Bonus Action to become visible again

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DurationEndTrigger.item_unequipped
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The invisible condition ends when the ring is removed. No existing DurationEndTrigger variant covers item removal as an end condition. This is distinct from 'dispel' (which targets magic effects) and from 'target_dons_armor' (which covers donning, not doffing).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You remain Invisible until the ring is removed
